name: possessio
description: Deps for the possessio Worker (worker/), the Model B keeper (keeper/) and the mini-app Solana leg (miniapp/). Solidity lives under src/ (foundry), the trading agent under mcp/xtrade (self-contained). The @solana/* + bs58 deps were previously installed ad-hoc and were silently pruned by a plain `npm install`; they are declared here so the keeper's test suites are reproducible from a clean clone.

scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo 'pre-commit scrub armed (CI enforces it regardless)'
scripts.test: node keeper/test/keeper.test.js && node keeper/test/rule-signature.test.js && node keeper/test/secret-resolve.test.js && node keeper/test/scrub.test.mjs
